decisions.reason: The firm cut several similar handle designs in 2019 and this single design has not appeared since, which suggests it falls below aspiration, and rising material costs in 2022 favour moving its resources to the core range and new development.

A multi-model lever family supports the system-breadth strategy in a still-solid construction market, so despite its absence from the website it is more likely kept than rationalized like the dropped families.

As the flagship of the move toward digital building organization, the electronic access system gets strategic commitment and slack to mature, even though its recent low visibility adds some risk of a shortfall against aspiration.
